yt_title: Day 9 of 10 — Forty-Two Rupees | Anaya's Ten Days EP2
short:
Papa comes home in nine days.

Under her bed was a tin she'd been filling since the rains.
Forty-two rupees.

A proper welcome needs three things.
Forty-two rupees buys one.
cta:
She crossed out the present… then un-crossed it 🧡
